remoteAssign.title: Remote dispatch
remoteAssign.subtitle: Assign a shipment to a driver who already has it, without a warehouse scan.
remoteAssign.explain1: Sometimes a driver picks up a shipment directly from the sender, or takes one that did not go through the normal warehouse flow.
remoteAssign.explain2: Once you have confirmed by phone that the driver has the shipment in hand, you can assign it to them remotely. The shipment moves directly to "Picked up".
remoteAssign.bullet1: Any undelivered shipment can be assigned
remoteAssign.bullet3: Every assignment is logged (who, when, why)
remoteAssign.ctaSubtitle: Find the shipment, choose the driver, confirm.
remoteAssign.modalSubtitle: Assign a shipment to a driver who already has it, without a scan.
remoteAssign.searchPlaceholder: Search by tracking, recipient or city...
remoteAssign.alreadyAssigned: Already assigned to {{name}} — will be reassigned
remoteAssign.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. picked up directly from the sender, shipment left at the warehouse...
remoteAssign.confirmCheck: I called the driver and confirmed they have the shipment in hand.
remoteAssign.confirmHint: This action sets the shipment to "Picked up" and makes it deliverable immediately.
